work.description: DCLXXXI: complete Sincera fidei four-section body including final datum LF7562–7567. Geometry warning on leaf64 resolves to running header LF7490 [602,272,1271,316], followed by ordinary left body LF7493 [275,344,766,377] then right LF7559 [786,347,1263,375]. The header creates R/L/R screen sequence; substantive text is normal L/R. No historical omission. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
